WB Game CJK JP, SC and TC (Regular and Medium)

Derived from Noto Sans CJK, as included in the game's original font assets.
Copyright (c) 2014, 2015 Adobe Systems Incorporated (http://www.adobe.com/).
Licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1; see fonts-OFL.txt
in the package, or OFL.txt alongside this source notice.

Modifications for this port: retain characters used by the game's text assets
and native read-only strings, plus U+0020 through U+33FF and U+FFFD where mapped.
Unused glyphs and their unused subroutines are removed. Internal family and
PostScript names are changed to WB Game CJK / WBGameCJK. Original copyright
and license metadata are preserved. Retained outlines, advances, vertical
metrics and representative raster output are checked against the originals.
The filenames remain as aliases for the game's existing file requests.
The original full fonts are not modified.

Full OFL text retrieved from:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/main/Sans/LICENSE
